digest.component_or_area: Model fallback orchestration and capability routing
propositions: Direct Anthropic fallback arms for frontier and standard model classes must be configured in rebar.toml; trivial remains single-arm until direct Haiku parity is measured

Capability intersection across Bedrock/Anthropic chains conservatively downgrades the primary model's native structured output to prompted output, silently affecting all calls regardless of whether fallback is invoked

Direct Anthropic Sonnet has been live-proven to support native structured output and thinking; the exact model ID capability row must be recorded to enable symmetric fallback without capability degradation
Current whole-chain capability intersection in runner.py remains unchanged; mixed Bedrock/Anthropic chains disable prompt caching due to provider-specific cache style differences

Per-attempt request shaping (output mode, cache settings, sampling, tools) is an approved redesign for future heterogeneous fallback chains but not required for this symmetric direct-Anthropic configuration
